basic_info.description: List price is Probate Court Minimum Overbid amount. Experience elevated city living in this spacious one-bedroom corner unit with stunning views. Located on the 20th floor of the legendary Hamilton Building, this highly desirable floor plan is rarely available. The living room showcases sweeping vistas of Nob Hill & the Transamerica Pyramid, complemented by a wood-burning fireplace, rich crown molding, built-ins, & a closet. From the bedroom, wake up to scenic sights of Buena Vista Park, Lone Mountain, & Cathedral Hill. The entry hall includes space perfect for a home workspace. A mid-century galley kitchen offers ample cabinet & counter space, a pantry, built-in oven, 4 burner-stove, & stainless fridge. The bathroom features a walk-in shower & updated vanity. Only one shared wall enhances the sense of privacy. Steps from Union Square, transit, & SF's most iconic sights, the building is a true Art Deco masterpiece with a dramatic lobby, 24-hour desk service, ballroom, fitness center, BBQ patio, & sky deck. Don't miss it!
